description.value: You can will the smoke from your censer to expand and contract. When you light your censer, you can choose the size of the smoke emanation: 10 feet, 15 feet, or 20 feet. In addition, the first time each round an enemy Casts a Spell or takes a linguistic action while within the emanation, they possibly choke on the smoke. They must attempt a Fortitude saving throw against your class DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Sickened]{Sickened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Sickened]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure). The target of your@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Exploit Vulnerability]{ Exploit Vulnerability} takes a –1 status penalty to this save. This is an inhaled poison effect.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
